systems.system: Plan d'action national pour le développement des villes intelligentes
systems.owner: MINHDU and MINPOSTEL with UN-Habitat; Orange, MTN and CAMTEL named for infrastructure, FEICOM for commune financing, ANTIC for digital regulation
systems.tiers: launched 8 September 2026; cities, with communes and regions (CTD) named as lead actors; traffic, waste, smart lighting, neighbourhood security and digitalised municipal services

note: A smart-city plan at launch; it states nothing about the connection of commune offices.
